title: Scenario 2: DNS Data Exfiltration
description: Attackers use DNS queries to exfiltrate data by encoding information in subdomain names. These queries are often much longer than normal DNS lookups.
hunt_for: Unusually long DNS queries (>50 characters), multiple subdomain levels, queries for suspicious TLDs, or high volume of DNS queries from a single source.
detection_tips: Look for DNS queries with very long subdomains
Check for TXT record queries (often used in tunneling)
Look for high DNS query volume from single processes
key_indicators: Base64 or hex-encoded patterns in queries
